scope: exploratory single-day mechanism test; never trading approval
source: Tardis Binance Futures BTCUSDT 2020-02-01 free sample
jump_definition: training-period 95th percentile of future 60-second maximum absolute midpoint excursion
primary_comparison: baseline logistic model versus baseline plus concentration features on untouched final 20 percent
primary_gate: test average-precision improvement > 0.02 and positive Brier improvement
block_inference: 10-minute non-overlapping test blocks; 1000 deterministic bootstrap resamples
multiple_testing_rule: targeted feature results are descriptive and require replication; no single p-value establishes a hypothesis
